the prevalence of preconception folic acid use among Lebanese women was 14%, and that higher socio-economic status, low parity and having a previous history of spontaneous abortions were significantly related to preconceptional use.

the prevalence of folic acid supplement intake among women in Lebanon is low, that the use of folic acid supplementation in Lebanon is associated with socio-economic status, and that women with a history of spontaneous abortion were more likely to use folic acid supplements.
